findings.title: Executing release policy module without integrity verification
findings.message: The release policy script is executed in-process by path. It only checks for symlinks and does not verify the file's integrity or that it belongs to the git-tracked source. A modified or untracked release-sdk.py can approve public output, since the public gate relies entirely on it.
findings.suggestion: Verify that release-sdk.py is tracked and unmodified in the checked-out commit (for example via git diff/ls-files) before executing it, or invoke it as a subprocess from a trusted location.

findings.title: Source state sampled after gates, not atomic with them
findings.message: The release gates and the source_state snapshot are taken at separate times. The source can change between them, so the recorded release_source may not match the state that was approved. A TOCTOU gap remains in the authorization recorded in the manifest.
findings.suggestion: Capture source_state before release_gates and compare it afterward, refusing if the two differ, so the recorded state is the one that was gated.
findings.evidence:
release_policy.release_gates(ROOT, metadata, True)
    release_source = release_policy.source_state(ROOT) if public else None
